text: dsh-publicwww 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 Harness 的 MCP 客户端连接 PublicWWW 服务。补丁配置 streamable HTTP 传输并注册 publicwww 服务，供 DSH agent 调用搜索、账户和文档工具。用户可查找加载指定脚本、使用某个库或包含追踪标识的网站。可选的 PUBLICWWW_TOKEN 环境变量提供 Bearer 授权；未设置时仍可查看工具和文档。搜索查询发送到 api.publicwww.com。

dsh-publicwww connects DSH to PublicWWW through MCP. It registers search, account, and documentation tools over streamable HTTP. Agents can find sites using a script or library. PUBLICWWW_TOKEN optionally provides authorization; queries go to api.publicwww.com.
帮我找出哪些网站加载了某个指定的 JavaScript 文件。
我想查找使用某个前端库或网站组件的站点。
Find websites that include a particular script or tracking identifier.
dsh-publicwww 的功能「网站源码搜索」：通过 PublicWWW MCP 工具查询包含指定脚本、库或追踪 ID 的网站，并返回搜索结果供 DSH agent 使用。
dsh-publicwww 使用前须知：网站源码搜索请求会发送给 api.publicwww.com；可在 PUBLICWWW_TOKEN 中提供 Bearer token 以授权服务请求。

dsh-publicwww README · PublicWWW for DeepSeek Harness：Search the source code (HTML, JavaScript, CSS) of hundreds of millions of websites
from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): which sites
load a script, use a library, carry a tracking id or a widget.

dsh-publicwww README · PublicWWW for DeepSeek Harness：This plugin connects the PublicWWW MCP server, `https://api.publicwww.com/mcp`,
through DeepSeek Harness's own MCP client. The agent gets PublicWWW's tools:
`search`, `account`, `read_docs` (the documentation and prices) and eight for
clusters, as `mcp__publicwww__<tool>`.

dsh-publicwww README · Setup：Issue a token on your [profile page](https://publicwww.com/profile/api) - the
tools need a paid plan, a free account gets the documentation only - and keep it
in the environment:

```sh
export PUBLICWWW_TOKEN=...
```

Then add the plugin to a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:publicwww-com/dsh-publicwww
```

or use the patch for a single run:

```sh
dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml
```

dsh-publicwww README · Setup：DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview; if a newer version changes the plugin
format, the server itself stays the same - any MCP client that can send an
`Authorization: Bearer` header works.

dsh-publicwww README · Asking："Which sites load angular.min.js?", "Find shops on .de that use the Klarna widget
and show the code around the match", "How many PublicWWW searches do I have left
today?" The query syntax: [publicwww.com/docs/query-syntax](https://publicwww.com/docs/query-syntax/).
